title: add rbacv2-policy-migration-harness-and-kms-affinity-validator
author: Elena Martinez
release_notes: Adds an offline RBACv2 migration harness, a KMS affinity validator that flags region mismatches, and an audit enrichment step to attach policy-diff metadata to forwarding logs.
description: Context: customers and internal audits have called out drift between legacy RBAC rules and the new RBACv2 schema plus occasional KMS usage that violates region pin policies. This PR introduces two complementary developer-facing tools and a lightweight runtime guard: 1) rbacv2-migrate: a deterministic migration harness that ingests legacy policy bundles and emits candidate RBACv2 policy sets with a policy-diff report and test vectors; 2) kms-affinity-validator: a preflight validator that runs as an admission check and CI plugin to detect requests where requested KMS CMK locations are incompatible with tenant/route region pins and surface a remediation suggestion; 3) audit-enricher: an optional middleware that annotates audit log entries with policy-diff ids and validator outcomes so compliance teams can correlate incidents with migration artifacts. Key changes: added a standalone CLI under tools/rbac-migration, a go package pkg/security/kms/affinity for validators, an audit hook in internal/audit/enricher.go, CI policy-lint job and test fixtures. Checklist: 1) migration harness outputs reversible mappings and includes test vectors; 2) validator covers AWS/GCP/Azure CMK location formats and configurable geozones; 3) audit enrichment is opt-in via config and respects PII scrubbing rules; 4) added staged rollout: feature flag rollout -> canary in dedicated -> global. Testing: unit tests for policy compiler (70+ cases), integration tests verifying validator against sample tenant manifests, end-to-end smoke that runs migration output through the policy simulator; manual dry-run executed against two internal clusters. Rollout plan: land to main but gating the runtime guard behind feature flag "rbacv2_affinity_guard"; follow-up tasks include adding migration UI in Console and bulk migration job in control plane. Related: ENG-2634 covers migration acceptance criteria; SUP-4281 is an enterprise support case that prompted affinity checks.
